# Vendored browser code

`mediabunny.js` is Mediabunny 1.61.0 (`dist/bundles/mediabunny.min.mjs` from the
`mediabunny` npm package), unmodified. The studio page loads it to put music
videos together in the browser with WebCodecs.

Mediabunny is by Vanilagy and contributors, under the Mozilla Public License 2.0
(`mediabunny.LICENSE`). Its source is at https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny
and in the npm package, `npm pack mediabunny@1.61.0`.
